summary: Three blocking findings: R4's README fix is forbidden by V06's byte-identical clause and owned by no phase (the doc charter's five surfaces do not reach support/iac-agent/README.md); V09 carries a doc-truth universal that collides with the R6/N5 ruling keeping /work/IaCAgent alive; and the hasChanges contract the plan records as unverified is readable in JenkinsPipelineUtils and uses full-match `==~`, which the plan never states.
